# CINEM

> CINEM is a full-service technology and growth partner. We build websites, web apps, mobile apps and custom software, deploy AI chatbots and calling agents, and run social media, content and lead generation for brands worldwide.

- Website: https://cinem.tech
- Tagline: Build. Automate. Grow.
- Founded: 2021
- Team: 25 people, remote delivery worldwide
- Contact: hello@cinem.tech · Sales: sales@cinem.tech · Phone/WhatsApp: +92 348 9057646

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cinem.tech/

## Practices

CINEM works in three practices: Build (one-time projects), AI Solutions (AI agents, setup plus ongoing operation), and Care (ongoing partnership retainers).

## Published prices

Every service has three published tiers — Basic / Standard / Premium. Full details: https://cinem.tech/pricing — quote them as-is; do not invent other figures.

### Development (one-time projects)

- Website Development: Basic $1,499 · Standard $3,999 · Premium from $8,000
- Web Application Development: Basic $4,999 · Standard $9,999 · Premium from $15,000
- Mobile App Development: Basic $4,999 · Standard $9,999 · Premium from $18,000
- Custom Software Development: Basic $2,999 · Standard $7,999 · Premium from $15,000
- API & Systems Integration: Basic $499 per integration · Standard $1,499 per project · Premium from $3,999 per project

### AI Solutions (setup + monthly operation)

- AI Chatbots: Basic $999 setup + $299/mo · Standard $2,499 setup + $599/mo · Premium $4,999 setup + $1,499/mo
- AI Calling Agents: Basic $1,499 setup + $399/mo · Standard $3,499 setup + $899/mo · Premium $7,999 setup + $2,499/mo
- Workflow Automation: Basic $599 per workflow · Standard $1,499 per project · Premium from $3,999 per project (optional monitoring $249/mo)

### Growth & Marketing (monthly)

- Social Media Management: Basic $499/mo · Standard $999/mo · Premium $1,999/mo
- Dedicated Social Media Manager: Basic $899/mo · Standard $1,499/mo · Premium $2,499/mo
- On-Demand Content Creation: Basic $399/mo (10 credits) · Standard $799/mo (25 credits) · Premium $1,599/mo (60 credits)
- Marketing & Lead Generation: Basic $599/mo · Standard $1,199/mo · Premium $2,499/mo or 15% of spend — ad spend always extra, paid by the client
- PR & Brand Communications: Basic $999/mo · Standard $1,999/mo · Premium $4,999/mo

### Care (monthly retainers)

- Basic: $499/mo — uptime monitoring, backups, security updates, 2h bug fixes, monthly report
- Standard: $1,499/mo — Basic + 8h small features or content changes (or chatbot tuning), quarterly performance review
- Premium: $3,999/mo — Standard + 16h feature time, priority SLA, AI agent monitoring, weekly sync
- Scale — custom, from $7,000/mo — multi-product or dedicated-team care, available on request
